# Simon Rule Snapshot

Source: Invent with Python, Simon clone.

Vendor artifact:
- `simulate.py` downloaded from `https://inventwithpython.com/simulate.py`

Rules abstracted for VQA generation:
- The game uses four colored buttons.
- A sequence of colors is played one color at a time.
- The highlighted button marks the current color in the sequence.
- Static VQA frames show the four buttons and a compact sequence strip.
- Generated questions ask for the highlighted color or the next color in the shown sequence.
